Kuriana Boddho Bhumi: The site of largest mass execution in 1971
2023-03-21T09:37:40+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news/kuriana-boddho-bhumi-the-site-largest-mass-execution-1971-3276741

During the 1971 Liberation War, the largest and most infamous killing field was located in Nesarabad upazila of Pirojpur in Barisal division, where most of the mass executions took place.

Watch the history of the Kuriana Boddho Bhumi in today's Star Special.
